name: Project Observer
summary: A local-first multi-project dashboard that restores project state, development history, and verification evidence for AI-assisted software projects.

goals.title: Read Git activity and working-tree state
Show project overview and per-project details
Observe Project Observer itself from day one
Evolve a general Project State Model
Import Codex / Claude / other agent sessions
Separate claimed completion from verified completion
Track long-term project complexity and maintainability signals

notes: Do not invent product next steps by default; only show evidence-backed unfinished items.
The tool must remain general-purpose and analyze itself using the same rules as other projects.
